summary: UKMTO issued warning 117-26 regarding maritime security threats in the region. Iran launched two ballistic missiles detected over UAE waters. Israeli forces targeted Hamas commanders in Sheikh Jarrah area of Gaza. Explosions reported in southern Lebanon targeting Israeli actions.
key_points: UKMTO issued warning 117-26 for maritime security threats in the region (Source: @shin_persian/9025).
Two ballistic missiles from Iran detected over UAE waters, one landing in territorial waters and one outside national borders (Source: @inon_yttach/9876).
Israeli forces targeted Hamas commanders in Sheikh Jarrah area of Gaza, with Palestinian media reporting six killed and ten wounded (Source: @manniefabian/58991).
Explosions reported in southern Lebanon in areas including Bint Jbeil, Maroun al-Ras and Blida following Israeli actions (Source: @SharghDaily/178843).
Israeli forces struck three Palestinian Islamic Jihad positions and three munitions depots in Beit Lahia area of northern Gaza (Source: @New_security8200/203356).
Iranian President Raisi arrived in Baghdad for meetings with Iraqi officials (Source: @naya_foriraq/88135).
UAE suspended all commercial transactions and financial transfers with Iran pending further notice (Source: @VahidOnline/77945).

sections.threat_assessment: Regional tensions are escalating with multiple actors conducting operations across borders. Iran's missile launches over UAE waters represent a significant escalation in regional military posturing. Israeli operations in Gaza and Lebanon indicate ongoing campaign against Hamas and Palestinian Islamic Jihad infrastructure. The suspension of UAE-Iran trade relations suggests severe deterioration in diplomatic engagement.
sections.regional_response: Iraq received Iranian President Qalibaf with official ceremonies, indicating continued regional cooperation despite tensions. UAE's suspension of all commercial transactions with Iran represents a significant economic response to regional security concerns. Hezbollah and Hamas operations continue to target Israeli positions across multiple fronts. Regional countries are monitoring developments closely while maintaining diplomatic channels.
sections.intelligence_notes: Multiple simultaneous operations across Gaza, Lebanon, and UAE waters suggest coordinated regional campaign. Iranian missile launches over UAE represent unprecedented direct challenge to Gulf security. Israeli targeting of Hamas commanders in Sheikh Jarrah indicates focus on leadership decapitation strategy. UAE's economic sanctions against Iran signal severe deterioration in regional diplomatic relations.
